notes: עַד לְ is fused to the one word for, headed on the governing עַד (rules 23, 30).

The competing reading takes as at as one rendering of the comparative כְּ under rule 30's one-rendering condition; the accepted reading marks at added because subtraction leaves the comparison stated by as alone. The note records the tie under rule 8.
The demonstrative זֶה takes the single written this and both articles in the phrase are unrepresented, exactly as הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא → that place divides (rules 41, 47).
